thread:
Anna: Heads-up — Aurion Analytics wants a 3-week POC and will bring their own model family (aurion-9b-halo). Requirements: streaming chat, function-calls, 25k token KV sessions, EU residency + customer-managed KMS. Can we scope compatibility and timeline?
Rafael: Ask them to upload a presigned S3 bundle with weights, tokenizer files, and a small manifest (attention type, norm, vocab size). Tokenizer check is first.
Priya: Commercial: Hosted POC is easiest but less p95 guarantees. Dedicated 3/6mo reserved gives predictable latency + lower unit cost. For 9B, q4_kv typically halves token cost vs fp16; latency bump usually +5-15ms/token.
Jon: Technical flags: check rotary vs ALiBi params, any grouped-query attention, and whether they use RMSNorm vs LayerNorm. Those affect kernel selection. Also confirm KV format (standard causal K,V per layer).
Anna: They also require us to complete an infosec questionnaire and supply KMS cert integration docs. I'll ask for a single security POC and the questionnaire back.
Rafael: Plan: 1) ingest artifacts -> tokenizer sanity 2) run compat-scan (attention/norm/tokenizer) 3) build recommended variants (fp16, q4_kv) 4) 48h dedicated canary for p50/p95/cost 5) KMS/residency review.
SecureBot: Ticket ONB-243210 created (steps: receive weights -> tokenizer check -> compat-scan -> variant-build -> 48h canary -> KMS signoff).
Priya: Can we offer a one-time onboarding engineering fee on the quote to cover compatibility work and security review?
Rafael: Yes, include onboarding fee + optional canary support. Also produce a compact compatibility matrix for the customer: model_id, attention_type, tokenizer_name, weight_format, recommended_variants, expected perf on H100/A100.
Jon: Quick answer re: 25k token sessions — we support sharded KV and prefix caching, but long contiguous sessions may require segmented attention or larger GPU memory. We'll validate during canary and recommend instance sizing.
Anna: They asked for a sample streaming curl and a small function-call example to test integration. Can someone paste one we can send now?
Rafael: Sample (will update model_id after variant build):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \ 
  -d '{"model":"aurion-9b-halo-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize last deploy failures"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_issue","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Priya: Assignments: @Rafael -> compat scan + comp matrix, @Jon -> perf baseline + kernel checks, @Priya -> pricing/commercial, @Anna -> customer coord + security questionnaire.
Anna: I'll request the S3 presign and questionnaire now and update ONB-243210 when artifacts land. Thanks team :rocket:
